text: A (in logic). Symbol for the universal affirmative judgment -- All men are mortal. Literature : notes on the origin of this and the other symbols of formal logic are to be found (sub verbis) in EISLER, Wörterb. d. philos. Begriffe. See also PRANTL, Gesch. d. Logik. ( J.M.B. )
